about: A company of 318 says that it ordained the faith with the apostles, with Christ among them. The scene then turns to Solomon, who sends word inviting the Queen to see the law of the kingdom and gain wisdom; she answers that she has been chosen by the God of Israel and will come. Solomon holds a magnificent supper, seating her behind him where she sees everything unseen, perfumes the room, and sends her spiced food. After the court withdraws he goes to her and asks her to talk of love until dawn. She asks him to swear by the God of Israel that he will not overpower her.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፱ is 20 + 9 = 29. በእንተ 'concerning' takes a construct or a noun; here it governs the numeral ፫፻፲ወ፰ = 300 + 10 + 8 = 318 (spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ, śälästu məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-sämäntu). The heading names the number, and the first words of the chapter show that it means the company of 318 who speak as 'we'; this passage itself does not say who they are (the number is the traditional count of the fathers of the Council of Nicaea, which is background, not stated here).

sentences.l: And-we-too we-ordained with-them, having-examined-exactly what they-spoke, those from-before-us, apostles; we 318 we-set-right and-we-made-straight(?) the-faith, while our-lord Jesus Christ (was) with-us; and-he he-ordained for-us how we-teach and-how we-do the-faith.
sentences.i: We too ordained together with them, having examined exactly what was said by those before us, the apostles. We, the 318, set the faith right and made it straight (?), while our Lord Jesus Christ was with us; and he laid down for us how we are to teach the faith and how we are to practice it.
sentences.n: ወንሕነኒ 'and we too' (ንሕነ 'we' + emphatic -ኒ 'also'). ሠራዕነ is the perfect 1st plural of ሠርዐ 'ordain, set in order' (the same root as ሕገ and ሥርዐት 'ordinance'). ምስሌሆሙ 'with them' (ምስለ + ሆሙ) points back to the apostles named at the end of the clause. ጠዩቀነ is a gerund (1st plural) of ጠየቀ 'examine exactly, verify': 'having verified' (spelled with ዩ where ዪ would be usual). ዘነበቡ 'what they spoke' (ዘ- relative; ነበበ 'speak', perfect 3rd plural). እለ እምቅድሜነ 'those who (were) before us' (እለ plural relative; ቅድሜነ 'before us'), with ሐዋርያት 'apostles' in apposition. አርታዕነ is from አርትዐ 'make straight, set right' (causative of ርትዐ 'be straight, upright'); ወዓስተራታዕነ looks like a second, reinforcing verb from the same root (the form አስተራትዐ, with the long ዓ for አ), and I take it as 'and we made it straight' (?), a near-synonym; the exact stem is uncertain (አስተራትዐ is only my reconstruction of the form, so the glossary gives the root ርትዐ). ሃይማኖተ 'faith' is accusative. እንዘ + noun 'while' (circumstantial): the Lord was with them. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ + ከመ), as in ch. 28. ንሜህር is the 1st plural imperfect of መሀረ (also written ምህረ) 'teach', the same verb as ይሜህር in ch. 23; 'learn' would be the tä-stem ተምህረ, so 'how we teach' stands. ንገብር 'we do, practise'; ሃይማኖተ is the object of both verbs. The unit ends at ፨, a stronger mark of division.

sentences.l: And-he-indeed, king Solomon, he-sent to-her, to-queen, saying:
sentences.i: But King Solomon, for his part, sent word to the Queen, saying:
sentences.n: A sharp change of scene, introduced with ወውእቱሰ 'and he, for his part' (ውእቱ 'he' + contrastive -ሰ). ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን 'king Solomon' stands in apposition, without an article, as Geʿez regularly has it. ለአከ is ለአከ 'he sent', and ላቲ is 'to her' (ለ- + ቲ); ለንግሥት restates 'her' as 'to the Queen' (not an object marker; as in ch. 28 ንግሥት is the title, not a name). እንዘ ይብል 'saying' (እንዘ + imperfect: 'while he says'), which introduces the quotation that follows through the next five units. The unit ends at ፤, mid-sentence.

sentences.n: እምድኅረ 'since, after' (እም 'from' + ድኅረ 'after') with the perfect መጻእኪ 'you (fem.) came' (መጽአ 'come'; -ኪ the 2nd feminine ending) and the contrastive -ሰ. ዝየአ 'here' (ዝየ with a final አ; the form is unusual, so the reading is not wholly sure). ለምንት 'why' (ለ- + ምንት). ተሐውሪ is the 2nd feminine imperfect of ሖረ (also written ሐወረ), which is 'go, walk, travel'; the sense 'go away' is taken from the situation, since in ch. 28 she asked to return home. ዘእንበለ ትርአዪ 'without your seeing' (ዘእንበለ 'without' + subjunctive ትርአዪ, 2nd feminine of ርእየ 'see'). ሕገ መንግሥት 'law-of kingdom' is a construct chain, 'the law (order) of the kingdom', that is, how the royal court runs.

sentences.i: and how the supper is held for the chosen of our kingdom, after the likeness of the righteous, and how the nations are sent away, after the likeness of sinners,
sentences.n: Two clauses, each opened by ወዘከመ 'and how'. ይትገበር is the passive (ተ-stem) of ገብረ 'do, make': 'is done, is held'; ድራር 'supper, evening meal' is its subject. ለኅሩያነ መንግሥትነ 'for the chosen-ones of our kingdom' (ኅሩያን, plural of ኅሩይ 'chosen'; a construct chain with መንግሥትነ 'our kingdom'). በአምሳለ 'in the likeness of, after the pattern of' (አምሳል 'likeness, pattern'), with ጻድቃን 'righteous ones' and ኃጥኣን 'sinners'. The parallel is plain: the court's table mirrors the judgment, with the righteous seated and sinners dismissed. ይሰደዱ is a plural imperfect of ሰደደ 'drive away, expel'; I read it as a passive ('are driven away'), but the form is not fully clear (it could be active, 'the nations drive away'), so the voice is uncertain. አሕዛብ 'nations, peoples' (the gentiles) is the subject.

sentences.n: ወእምኔሁ 'and from him/it' (እም + ኔሁ); 'it' is the likeliest referent, the whole order of the court just described, though 'from him', Solomon, is also possible. ትረክቢ is the 2nd feminine imperfect of ረከበ 'find, obtain'. ጥበበ is accusative 'wisdom'. The ። here follows the word without a wordspace; it ends a sentence, not Solomon's message, which goes on in the next two units.

sentences.i: Come after me, and you will dwell in my splendor, in the tents (?), and I will fulfill it for you, and you will come to know the law of the kingdom as well; for you have loved wisdom, and she will stay with you to your end and for ever.
sentences.n: ኒዒ is the imperative feminine singular of the verb 'come' (the usual spelling is ንዒ); በድኅሬየ 'after me, behind me' (በ + ድኅሬ + የ 'my'). ወትነብሪ 'and you will dwell' (2nd feminine imperfect of ነበረ 'sit, dwell'). ጸዳል 'brightness, splendor' with the suffix -የ 'my'. ደባትር: I take it as a plural of ደብተራ 'tent, tabernacle' (?), so 'in the tents' (ደብተራ is the tent of testimony in ch. 17-19); the plural would equally suit ደብተር 'scroll, book' (the same Greek loanword), so this is a guess. ወእፌጽም ለኪ 'and I will complete for you' (ፈጸመ 'complete, fulfil'; the thing fulfilled is not stated). ወታአምሪ 'and you will know' (2nd feminine imperfect of አእመረ 'know'); ሕገ መንግሥትኒ 'the law of the kingdom also' (-ኒ 'also'). እስመ introduces the reason: አፍቀርኪያ 'you loved her' (አፍቀረ 'love', 2nd feminine perfect, with -ያ 'her'), the object restated by ለጥበብ 'wisdom' (ጥበብ is grammatically feminine). ትነብር is then 3rd feminine, 'she (wisdom) will dwell'. ደኃሪትኪ 'your end' (ደኃሪት 'last, end' + -ኪ 'your'). ወለዓለምኒ 'and for the age (for ever) also'. The speaker is still Solomon; his message continues into the next unit.

sentences.l: For prophecy it-appears at tongue.
sentences.i: For prophecy shows itself in the tongue (?)."
sentences.n: A short, sentence-like saying, and the sense is uncertain (?). እስመ 'for'. ትንቢት 'prophecy'. ያስተርኢ is the 3rd masculine imperfect of አስተርአየ 'appear, be made manifest' (ርእየ 'see', with the አስተ- reflexive-causative prefix), so 'it becomes visible'. በኀበ is literally 'at the place of' and often just 'with, at'; ልሳን 'tongue, speech'. I take it as 'prophecy is manifest in speech'. It may be Solomon's own reason for the promise just made, or an editor's comment. I take it as Solomon's: the next unit says she sent word 'again, in turn' (ካዕበ ይእቲኒ), which presupposes that his message has only now ended, and the quotation marks follow that reading.

sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again, in turn' (ካዕበ adverbial accusative of ካዕብ 'second, double'). ይእቲኒ 'she too' (ይእቲ 'she' + -ኒ). ለአከት is the 3rd feminine perfect of ለአከ 'send' (see ለአከ in unit 2, of Solomon's message). The Queen's answer is introduced with እንዘ ትብል 'saying' (3rd feminine imperfect of ብህለ 'say', the verb whose perfect is ይቤ).

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ዓብድ ፡ አነ ፡ ኮንኩ ፡ ጠባበ ፡ በተሊወ ፡ ጥበብከ ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ምንንት ፡ እምአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኮንኩ ፡ ኅሪት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ አሚኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወእምይእዘሰ ፡ ኢያመልክ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ ዘእንበሌሁ ፤
sentences.tr: ʾənzä ʿabd ʾänä konku ṭäbabä bätäliwä ṭəbäbkä wäʾnəzä mənnət ʾəmʾämlakä ʾəsraʾel konku ḫərit bäʾnətä zati ʾäminot ʾəntä wəstä ləbyä wäʾməyʾəzäsä ʾiyamälk baʿdä zäʾnəbälehu
sentences.l: While fool I I-was, wise(?) by-following your-wisdom, and-while despised(?) I-was chosen from-God-of Israel, concerning this faith which (is) in my-heart; and-from-now-indeed not-he-worships [3ms; sic] another besides-him;
sentences.i: "Though I was a fool, I became wise (?) by following your wisdom; and though I was despised (?), I was chosen by the God of Israel, because of this faith which is in my heart; and from now on I will worship no other besides him;
sentences.n: Speech by the Queen. እንዘ ዓብድ አነ ኮንኩ: ዓብድ I take as ዕብድ 'foolish, mad' (ዐብደ 'be foolish'; the ዓ is a spelling variant); እንዘ 'while, though' and ኮንኩ 'I was / became' (ኮነ 'be', 1st singular). The order makes a pair with the next clause, so 'fool' contrasts with 'wise', and ምንንት with ኅሪት. ጠባበ 'wise' (?) is accusative, a predicate after ኮንኩ; I read it from ጠበበ 'be wise', but the form is not certain. በተሊወ ጥበብከ 'by following your wisdom' (ተሊወ, verbal noun of ተለወ 'follow'; ጥበብከ 'your wisdom', -ከ 'your', masculine). ምንንት: probably 'despised, rejected' (from መነነ), which is why the second pair reads as lowly-then-chosen; this is uncertain (?). Note that እምአምላከ እስራኤል stands directly after ምንንት, so it might belong to it ('despised by / estranged from the God of Israel') instead of to ኅሪት ('chosen by the God of Israel'); the sense of the contrast is the same either way. ኅሪት 'chosen' (feminine singular, agreeing with the speaker) and እምአምላከ እስራኤል 'by the God of Israel' (እም marking the agent, 'from'). በእንተ ዛቲ አሚኖት 'because of this faith' (አሚኖት 'faith', feminine; ዛቲ 'this', feminine), እንተ ውስተ ልብየ 'which is in my heart'. ወእምይእዘሰ 'and from now on' (the spelling ይእዘ is a variant of ይእዜ). ኢያመልክ is formally third person ('he does not worship'), the same oddity as ኢይሰግድ in ch. 28, where the sense is the Queen's own vow; I render it as first person ('I will not worship', አመልከ 'worship, serve'). ባዕደ 'another, a foreign one' (accusative), ዘእንበሌሁ 'besides him'. The unit ends at ፤.

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)

by, from the God of (እም- marking the agent + noun, construct አምላከ)
concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')

he does not worship; the sense is her vow, 'I will not worship' (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G; the form is 3ms though the speaker is the Queen, as ch. 28 ኢይሰግድ)
besides him, without him (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ሁ 'him')

sentences.t: ወበዝንቱሰ ፡ ዘትቤ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትወስከኒ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ ወክብረ ፡ ወእመጽእ ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፨

sentences.l: And-in-this-indeed which you-said, you-wished that you-add-to-me wisdom and-glory, and-I-will-come as you-wished.
sentences.i: And as for what you said in this, that you wished to add wisdom and glory to me: I will come, as you have wished."
sentences.n: ወበዝንቱሰ 'and in this indeed' (በ + ዝንቱ 'this', with -ሰ), picking up 'what you said'. ዘትቤ 'what you said' (ዘ + ትቤ, the 2nd masculine of ይቤ, whose prefix forms serve as its perfect: ይቤ 'he said', ትቤ 'you said' or 'she said'). ፈቀድከ 'you wished' (perfect 2nd masculine of ፈቀደ 'wish, want'), followed by ከመ ትወስከኒ 'that you add to me' (ወሰከ 'add, increase'; subjunctive 2nd masculine + -ኒ 'to me'), with ጥበበ ወክብረ 'wisdom and glory' as accusative objects. ወእመጽእ 'and I will come' (1st singular imperfect of መጽአ). በከመ ፈቀድከ 'as you wished'. The Queen accepts. The unit ends at ፨, and the speech ends with it.

morph.gloss: and in this, as for this (ወ- + በ- + demonstrative + contrastive -ሰ)
what you said (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ; the prefix forms of defective ይቤ serve as its perfect)
that you add to me (2ms subjunctive, G + -ኒ '1cs to me')
and I will come (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሐ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ወአልበሶሙ ፡ ለኅሩያኒሃ ፡ ወወሰከ ፡ ካዕበተ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ማእዱ ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ በአስተጠአጥኦ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሥርዐተ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ድሉት ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.tr: wätäfäśḥä sälomon bäʾnətäz wäʾälbäsomu läḫruyaniha wäwäsäkä kaʿbätä dibä maʾdu wäʾäzäzä bäʾästäṭäʾäṭʾo kʷəlo śərʿätä betu wäkʷlo ʿəlätä ʾənzä dəlut betu läsälomon nəguś
sentences.l: And-rejoiced Solomon because-of-this, and-he-clothed-them, to-her-chosen-ones, and-he-added a-second-time upon his-table, and-he-commanded in-arranging(?) all order-of his-house and all day, while ready his-house, of-Solomon king;
sentences.i: Solomon rejoiced at this. He clothed her chosen ones, he doubled the provision on his table (?), and he gave orders for the arranging (?) of the whole order of his house, day after day, while the house of King Solomon stood ready;
sentences.n: ወተፈሥሐ 'and he rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ, ተ-stem of ፈሥሐ). በእንተዝ 'because of this' (በእንተ + ዝ). ወአልበሶሙ 'and he clothed them' (አልበሰ, causative of ለበሰ 'wear'; -ሙ 'them'), ለኅሩያኒሃ 'her chosen-ones' (ኅሩያን with -ሃ 'her') restating the 'them': the Queen's chosen attendants. ወወሰከ ካዕበተ ዲበ ማእዱ 'and he added a second time upon his table' (ካዕበተ accusative of ካዕብ 'double'): I take it as 'he doubled (the provision)', but the idiom is uncertain (?). ወአዘዘ 'and he commanded' (አዘዘ). በአስተጠአጥኦ: the verb root is unclear to me (?), and I take it as an infinitive 'in putting in order, in making ready'. ኵሎ ሥርዐተ ቤቱ 'all the order of his house' (ኵሎ accusative, ሥርዐት 'ordinance, order'), ኵሎ ዕለተ 'every day, all day' (accusative of time). እንዘ ድሉት ቤቱ ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ: 'while ready (was) his house, that of Solomon the king' (ድሉት 'ready, prepared'; ለሰሎሞን restating the possessor, as it often does). The unit ends at ፤.

and he clothed them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ለብሰ + -ሙ '3mp them')
to her chosen ones (ለ- + plural ኅሩያን, ኅሩያኒ- before a suffix, + -ሃ '3fs her')
a second time, double (noun/adverb, accusative; from ካዕብ 'double'; ወወሰከ ካዕበተ 'he doubled', idiom uncertain) (?)
(infinitive-like derived form of an unclear root; perhaps 'arranging, putting in order') (?)
day (noun, fem.; construct 'day of'; plural መዋዕል)

Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')

sentences.t: ወአሜሃ ፡ አስተዳለዋ ፡ በክብር ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ በፍሥሓ ፡ ወበሰላም ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ወበምሕረት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትሕትና ፡ ወየውሀት ።

sentences.l: And-then he-prepared-her in-honor exceedingly, in-joy and-in-peace, in-wisdom and-in-mercy, with all humility and-gentleness.
sentences.i: Then he made preparation for her (?) with great honor, with joy and peace, with wisdom and mercy, and with all humility and gentleness.
sentences.n: ወአሜሃ 'and then' (አሜሃ). አስተዳለዋ is አስተዳለወ 'he prepared, made ready' with -ዋ 'her'; taken strictly it says 'he prepared her', and I read it as 'he made ready (the reception) for her' (?). The በ- 'in, with' repeated on each noun marks manner: በክብር 'with honor', በፍሥሓ 'with joy', በሰላም 'with peace', በጥበብ 'with wisdom', በምሕረት 'with mercy', then ምስለ ኵሉ ትሕትና 'with all humility' and የውሀት 'gentleness, meekness'. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. A list of virtues, not of acts: the host's manner is the point.

morph.gloss: and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
he prepared her; perhaps 'made ready for her' (3ms perfect, ʾastä-stem + -ዋ '3fs her') (?)
and in mercy (ወ- + በ- + noun, fem.)
and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + noun, from የዋህ)

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ተሠርዐ ፡ ማእድ ፡ ዘንጉሥ ፡ በከመ ፡ ሕገ ፡ መንግሥት ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾməz täśärʿä maʾd zänguś bäkämä ḥəgä mängəśt
sentences.l: And-after-this was-set-in-order table of-king according-to law-of kingdom;
sentences.i: After this the king's table was set out according to the law of the kingdom;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this' (እም + ዝ). ተሠርዐ is the passive of ሠርዐ 'set in order, ordain'; ማእድ 'table', ዘንጉሥ 'that of the king' (ዘ- + ንጉሥ, the periphrastic genitive: 'the table of the king'). በከመ ሕገ መንግሥት 'according to the law of the kingdom', a callback to Solomon's message above (ሕገ መንግሥት is again the construct 'law-of kingdom').

morph.gloss: it was set in order, arranged (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሠርዐ)
according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)

sentences.t: ወንግሥትኒ ፡ ቦአት ፡ እንተ ፡ መፍልስት ፡ በጸዳል ፡ ወበክብር ፡ ወነበረት ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ድኅሬሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትሬኢ ፡ ወትትኤመር ፡ ወትጤይቅ ፡ ኵሎ ፤

sentences.l: and-queen-too she-entered, she of-the-migration(?), in-splendor and-in-glory, and-she-sat opposite his-back, where she-sees and-she-observes(?) and-she-examines everything;
sentences.i: and the Queen came in, the sojourner (?), in splendor and in glory, and she took her seat facing his back, from where she could see and take note (?) and examine everything;
sentences.n: ወንግሥትኒ 'and the Queen also / for her part' (-ኒ). ቦአት 'she entered' (ቦአ, 3rd feminine perfect). እንተ መፍልስት: እንተ is the feminine relative, but with no verb it is here 'she of the migration', I think 'the sojourner, the foreigner' (መፍልስት from ፈለሰ 'migrate'; uncertain). በጸዳል ወበክብር 'in splendor and in glory'. ወነበረት 'and she sat' (ነበረ), አንጻረ ድኅሬሁ 'opposite his back' (አንጻረ 'opposite, facing', a construct before ድኅሬሁ 'behind him, his back'): she sits behind him, facing his back. ኀበ ትሬኢ 'where she may see' (ትሬኢ, 3rd feminine imperfect of ርእየ). ትትኤመር: I take it as a reflexive 'she takes note, perceives' (?), the root being unclear. ትጤይቅ is from ጠየቀ 'examine exactly'. ኵሎ 'everything' (accusative). The seat is chosen so that she sees all and, as the next sentence says, is not herself seen.

migration, journey from afar (noun, from ፈለሰ 'migrate'; sense of 'እንተ መፍልስት' uncertain) (?)
and in glory, honour (ወ- + በ- + noun)
and she sat, dwelt (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
and she takes note, perceives (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, perhaps a tä-stem of አእመረ 'know'; root and form not certain) (?)

sentences.t: ወታነክር ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ በዘ ፡ ርእየት ፡ ወበዘ ፡ ሰምዐት ፡ ወትሴብሖ ፡ በልባ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወታስተዐጽብ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ዘርእየት ።

sentences.l: And-she-marvels exceedingly at-what she-saw and-at-what she-heard, and-she-praises-him in-her-heart, the-God-of Israel, and-she-wonders-at the-glory-of house-of kingdom which she-saw.
sentences.i: And she marveled greatly at what she saw and at what she heard, and she praised the God of Israel in her heart, and she wondered at the glory of the royal house which she had seen.
sentences.n: The verbs are 3rd feminine imperfects, used in narrative for repeated or continuing action: ታነክር 'she marvels' (አንከረ 'marvel, be astonished'); ትሴብሖ 'she praises him' (ሰብሐ 'praise'; -ሖ 'him'), then ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'the God of Israel' restates the 'him' (the God of Israel, 'him'); ታስተዐጽብ 'she wonders at' (አስተዐጸበ, a derived stem related, I think, to ዕጹብ 'marvelous, hard to grasp'; the sense of wonder is clear, and the published parts gloss it the same way). በዘ ርእየት ወበዘ ሰምዐት 'at what she saw and at what she heard' (ዘ- relative 'what'). ክብረ ቤተ መንግሥት 'the glory of the house of the kingdom', a construct chain of three nouns, i.e., the royal palace. ዘርእየት 'which she saw'.

morph.gloss: and she marvels (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, causative of ነከረ 'be strange')

sentences.l: For she-sees by-herself, and-as-for-her there-is-no one who-sees-her, as he-made for-her in-wisdom, he-who made-beautiful her-seat: having-spread ሜላተ(?) and-having-arranged(?) carpets, and-having-made ምስካተ(?) and-አብላቀ(?) and-አፍራጸ(?), having-sprinkled perfumes, and-having-arranged(?) ሚዓተ(?) and-cassia(?), having-ground(?) ቀንአተ(?) and-ስኂናተ(?).
sentences.i: For she saw for herself, while no one saw her, just as he had arranged for her with wisdom, he who made her seat beautiful: spreading out ሜላተ [melatä] (?) and arranging carpets (?), making ምስካተ [məskatä] (?), አብላቀ [ʾäblaqä] (?) and አፍራጸ [ʾäfraṣä] (?), sprinkling perfumes, arranging ሚዓተ [miʿatä] (?) and cassia (?), grinding (?) ቀንአተ [qänʾatä] (?) and ስኂናተ [səḫinatä] (?).
sentences.n: እስመ ትሬኢ ለሊሃ 'for she sees by herself' (ለሊሃ 'herself'). ወላቲሰ አልቦ ዘይሬኢያ 'and as for her, there is no one who sees her' (ለ- + ቲ, -ሰ contrastive; አልቦ 'there is not', ዘይሬኢያ 'who sees her'). It is the point of her seat. በከመ ገብረ ላቲ በጥበብ 'as he had made for her with wisdom'; ዘአሠነየ ምንባራ is a relative on Solomon, 'who made beautiful her seat' (አሠነየ 'make beautiful, good'; ምንባር (a variant spelling of መንበር) 'seat' with -ኣ 'her'). There follows a string of gerunds (ነጺፎ, ረቢቦ, ገቢሮ, ነዚኆ, ረቢቦ, መሪጎ), each a participial 'having done' that carries the same subject, Solomon; the nouns after them are accusative plurals in -ተ. Some of the objects are loanwords I can place, with caution: ቢሳጣተ looks like Arabic bisāṭ 'carpet'; ሜላተ may be Arabic mulāʾa 'sheet, covering'; ሰሊካተ may be Arabic salīkha 'cassia'; ምስካተ may belong to 'musk'. ዕፍረታተ 'perfumes, ointments' (ዕፍረት); ነዚኆ from ነዝኀ 'sprinkle'. ሚዓተ and ስኂናተ stand in a list with perfumes and cassia, so they are probably aromatics too (I think ሚዓ is a resinous incense, but I do not rely on it). ረቢቦ occurs twice and is rendered 'arranging (?)' both times. The rest (አብላቀ, አፍራጸ, ሚዓተ, ቀንአተ, ስኂናተ, and the exact verbs ረቢቦ and መሪጎ) I cannot analyze with confidence, so I leave them in Geʿez and the sense is only roughly given: a catalog of the furnishing and perfuming of her seat and the room.

sentences.l: And-when they-enter-it, to-that dwelling, exceedingly good (is) its-fragrance, and-it-satisfies without that-they-eat foods; the-sweetness-of its-smell.
sentences.i: And when they went into that chamber, its fragrance was exceedingly good, and it satisfied them without their eating food, by the sweetness of its scent.
sentences.n: ወሶበ 'and when'. ይበውእዎ is the 3rd plural imperfect of ቦአ 'enter' (ይበውኡ) with -ዎ 'it', and ለውእቱ ማኅደር 'that dwelling' (ማኅደር 'dwelling, abode, chamber') restates the 'it' as an object. ፈድፋደ ሠናይ መዐዛሁ 'exceedingly good (is) its fragrance' (መዐዛ 'fragrance' with -ሁ 'its'). The imperfects ይበውእዎ and ያጸግብ (አጸገበ, causative of ጸገበ 'be satisfied': 'it satisfies') are used for a general or repeated fact. ዘእንበለ ይብልዑ መባልዕተ 'without their eating foods' (በልዐ 'eat'; መባልዕት 'foods', accusative). ጣዕመ ጼናሁ 'the sweetness of its smell', a construct chain in the accusative used adverbially ('by, in respect of'): it was the sweetness of the scent that satisfied. The scene is the royal table-room, and 'they' is the diners in general.

sentences.l: And-he-sends to-her foods thirst-making(?) with-counsel and-with-wisdom, and-drinks መፂፃነ(?), fish(?), and-peppers strong; and-this he-does and-gives-her to-queen so-that she-eat from-it;
sentences.i: And he would send her, with counsel and with wisdom, foods that bring on thirst (?), and drinks, መፂፃነ [mäṣ́iṣ́anä] (?), fish (?), and strong peppers; all this he would do and give to the Queen so that she would eat of it;
sentences.n: ወይፌኑ 'and he sends' (ፈነወ 'send', imperfect, here habitual: 'he would send'); ላቲ 'to her'. መባልዐ 'foods' (accusative of መባልዕ). መጻምአ: from ጸምአ 'be thirsty', and the form most naturally means 'thirst-making' (?), so 'foods that cause thirst'; this is only a probable reading. በምክር ወበጥበብ 'with counsel and wisdom', i.e., with calculated purpose. መሳትየ 'drinks' (accusative of መሳትይ). መፂፃነ: I cannot analyze this (?); it may be an adjective qualifying 'drinks', as መጻምአ qualifies 'foods'. ሰመከ may be Arabic samak 'fish' (?). ፍልፍለ ጠቢቃተ: ፍልፍል is the Semitic loan for 'pepper' (Arabic fulful), and ጠቢቅ means 'strict, severe, strong', so 'strong peppers' (plural ጠቢቃተ); I take the list as spiced food. ወዘንተ ይገብር 'and this he does'. ወይሁባ ለንግሥት 'and he gives her, the Queen' (ይሁብ 'he gives' + -ኣ 'her'). ከመ ትብላዕ እምኔሁ 'so that she eat of it' (subjunctive 3rd feminine; በልዐ). The unit ends at ፨.

sentences.l: And-when was-completed thrice(?) and-seven-times(?) the-king's-table, and-they-went-in(?) stewards and-counselors and-attendants(?) and-servants, rose king and-went to queen and-he-said-to-her, in-their-being-alone: converse here about love until dawn.
sentences.i: And when the king's table had been completed, thrice and seven times (?), and the stewards and counselors and attendants (?) and servants had retired (?), the king rose and went to the Queen and said to her, being alone with her: "Converse here about love until dawn."
sentences.n: ወሶበ ተፈጸመ 'and when it was completed' (ተፈጸመ, passive of ፈጸመ). ሥልሰ ወስብዐ: two bare accusatives, ሥልሰ from ሥልስ 'third' (adverbially 'thrice, a third time') and ስብዐ from ሰብዐ 'seven' (here 'seven times'?). I take them together as 'thrice and seven times' (?), a count of the table's completion, but I cannot resolve it (?): 'the third and the seventh course' is also possible. ማእደ ንጉሥ 'the table of the king' (construct, accusative or nominative, used as the subject of the passive). ወአተዉ 'and they went in' (አተወ 'enter, go in', as in ch. 13-16 ወአተወ ውስተ ማኅደሩ 'he entered his dwelling', and ch. 28 ወአተወት ቤተ 'she went into / took up a house'); with no stated goal I take it as 'went in to their quarters, retired' (?). መገብት 'stewards' (those who feed), መማክርት 'counselors', መሐዛት 'attendants' (?), አግብርት 'servants' (plural of ገብር), a list of the court staff. ተንሥአ 'he rose' (ተንሥአ), ወሖረ ኀበ ንግሥት 'and went to the Queen'. ወይቤላ 'and he said to her'. በባሕቲቶሙ 'in their aloneness' (ባሕቲት 'aloneness' + -ሙ 'their', plural): a circumstantial phrase, 'they being alone'. ተናዘዚ is the 2nd feminine imperative of ተናዘዘ 'converse, confide'. ዝየ 'here'. በእንተ ፍቅር 'about love' (ፍቅር 'love'; it could also be 'for love'). እስከ ነግህ 'until dawn' (ነግህ 'dawn, morning').

sentences.i: She said to him: "Swear to me by your God, the God of Israel, that you will not overpower me. If I should stray from some small human law (?), I will go down into toil and sickness and distress on the way."
sentences.n: ወትቤሎ 'and she said to him' (ትቤ + -ሎ). መሐል is the imperative of መሐለ 'swear', ሊተ 'to me', በአምላክከ 'by your God' (the በ- of the oath), አምላከ እስራኤል 'God of Israel' (construct) in apposition. ከመ ኢትትኀየለኒ 'that you not prevail over me' (ተኀየለ 'be strong, prevail', with -ኒ 'me'): the oath asks that he not take her by force. The conditional that follows is hard (?). እመቦ ለእመ is a doubled 'if' (እመቦ 'if there is'; ለእመ 'if'); ተስሕትኩ 'I have erred / gone astray' (ተስሕተ, 1st singular perfect); ሕገ ሰብእ ነኣስ 'law of man, small', a construct chain with an adjective: I take ነኣስ 'small' as describing the law (or the man); it is masculine, so it can hardly describe the Queen herself, who uses feminine forms (ኅሪት above). The consequence is the Queen's own penalty: እወርድ 'I would go down' (ወረደ), ውስተ ጻማ ወሕማም ወምንዳቤ 'into toil, and sickness, and distress', በፍኖት 'on the way'. I read the apodosis as a plain statement of what transgression would cost her (it is an imperfect, 'I shall go down'), the reason she wants the oath, not as a curse; the exact logic is still not clear to me. The trailing ፨ ፨ ፨ ... closes the part, as at the end of ch. 28; nine marks in all, counting the one that ends the sentence.

glossary.ወአተዉ: አተወ — and they went in, entered (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G; here perhaps 'withdrew' (?))
glossary.ወአዘዘ: አዘዘ — and he commanded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወእመጽእ: መጽአ — and I will come (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወእምይእዘሰ: ይእዜ — and from now on, henceforth (ወ- + እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወእፌጽም: ፈጸመ — and I will fulfil, complete (ወ- + 1cs imperfect እፌጽም, G)
glossary.ወወሰከ: ወሰከ — and he added (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዓስተራታዕነ: ርትዐ — and we made straight, set right (ወ- + 1cp perfect of a derived stem of ርትዐ 'be straight', with ዓ for አ; the stem አስተራትዐ is my reconstruction, not a dictionary form I can confirm) (?)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወየውሀት: የውሀት — and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + noun, from የዋህ)
glossary.ወያጸግብ: አጸገበ — and it satisfies (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸገበ 'be sated')
glossary.ወይሁባ: ወሀበ — and he gives her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ይሁብ, G + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send')
glossary.ወገቢሮ: ገብረ — and having made (ወ- + gerund, G)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዓብድ: ዕብድ — foolish, a fool (adjective/noun; spelled ዓብድ)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem.; construct 'day of'; plural መዋዕል)
glossary.ዕፍረታተ: ዕፍረት — perfumes, incense (noun, plural ዕፍረታት, accusative)
glossary.ዘርእየት: ርእየ — what she saw (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘትቤ: ይቤ — what you said (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ; the prefix forms of defective ይቤ serve as its perfect)
glossary.ዘነበቡ: ነበበ — what they spoke (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — of the king (ዘ- genitive + noun)
glossary.ዘአሠነየ: አሠነየ — who made beautiful, adorned (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of ሠነየ)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
glossary.ዘእንበሌሁ: ዘእንበለ — besides him, without him (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.ዘይሬኢያ: ርእየ — who sees her (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ያ '3fs her')
glossary.ያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — he/it appears, is manifest (3ms imperfect, ʾastä-stem)
glossary.ይሰደዱ: ሰደደ — they are driven away, are expelled (3mp imperfect/jussive; passive sense, active form ሰደደ 'drive away') (?)
glossary.ይበውእዎ: ቦአ — they enter it (3mp imperfect, G + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — she too (3fs independent pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ደኃሪትኪ: ደኃሪት — your end (noun, fem., from ደኃሪ 'last' + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
glossary.ጠቢቃተ: ጠቢቅ — strong, severe (adjective, plural accusative ጠቢቃተ)
glossary.ጠባበ: ጠቢብ — wise (adjective; the accusative would be ጠቢበ, so the spelling ጠባበ is irregular; predicate after ኮንኩ) (?)
glossary.ጠዩቀነ: ጠየቀ — we having examined exactly, having verified (gerund 1cp, G; spelled ጠዩቀ- for ጠዪቀ-)
glossary.ፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2ms perfect, G)
glossary.፫፻፲ወ፰: ፫፻፲ወ፰ — 318, spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ (śälästu məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-sämäntu) 'three hundred and eighteen' (numeral)
glossary.፳፱: ፳፱ — 29, spoken ዕሥራ ወተስዐቱ (ʿəśra wä-täsʿatu) 'twenty-nine'; chapter number (numeral)
